y-m-40-02.material: Minseo akataura zvinotevera nezvehuwandu hwema divisors e natural number N. "Ma divisors e 12 i 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12, iyo i 6. Ma divisors e 18 i 1, 2, 3, 6, 9, 18, iyo i 6. Ma divisors e 20 i 1, 2, 4, 5, 10, 20, iyo i 6. Sezvo 12=2²×3, 18=2×3², 20=2²×5, huwandu hwema divisors i product yema exponents imwe neimwe pamwe ne 1 mu prime factorization." y-m-40-02.s.s2.hint.1: Pa peya imwe neimwe, wana a ne b, verenga chaizvo 2^a×3^b, uye utarise kuti i 200 kana kushoma.

y-m-40-02.s.s2.explain: (a, b)=(2, 3) inopa N=4×27=108, (3, 2) inopa 8×9=72, uye (5, 1) inopa 32×3=96. Dzese dzine (a+1)(b+1)=12. (1, 5) inopa 2×243=486, iyo i pamusoro pe 200, uye (0, 11) kana (11, 0) i hombe zvikuru. Maitiro ekupatsanura 12 kuita (a+1)×(b+1) anosarudza mhinduro.
y-m-40-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Uchishandisa ma divisors e 12=2²×3 semuenzaniso, tsanangura kuti sei huwandu hwema divisors e N=2^a×3^b i (a+1)×(b+1).
y-m-40-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Nyora ma divisors ese e 12, uye uronge mutebhura kuti 2 yakawanzwa kangani uye 3 yakawanzwa kangani mu divisor imwe neimwe.
y-m-40-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Nyora mitengo yese inogoneka yehuwandu hwenguva dzinowanzwa 2, uye uverenge kuti mapeya mangani apo wakaabatanidza nezviitiko zve 3.

y-m-40-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Wakataura kuti unoverenga nekubatanidza nzira dzekusarudza zvikamu zviviri here?
y-m-40-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Ma divisors e 12 i ane chimiro 2^i×3^j, apo i ine sarudzo 3 kubva ku 0, 1, 2 uye j ine sarudzo 2 kubva ku 0, 1. Kubatanidza nzira dzekusarudza i ne j kunopa 3×2=6, uye kazhinji i inomhanya kubva ku 0 kusvika ku a, saka pane sarudzo a+1, uye j ine sarudzo b+1, saka i (a+1)(b+1).
y-m-40-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Ma divisors e 12=2²×3 i 1, 2, 4, 3, 6, 12. Kana ukasarudza chikamu che 2 kubva ku 1, 2, 4 (kubva pa power ye 0 kusvika pa power ye 2, saka sarudzo 2+1) uye chikamu che 3 kubva ku 1, 3, uye ukawanza zvikamu zviviri, divisor imwe inosarudzwa. Saka pane nzira 3×2.

y-m-40-01.s.s2.r.a: Uku kukosha kwaJihu. Mugumisiro wekuverenga nzvimbo yehundreds sesarudzo 4 pasina kusiyanisa nyaya umo nzvimbo yeones i0 nenyaya umo i2 kana 4.
y-m-40-01.s.s2.r.b: Uku kukosha kunowanikwa nekuverenga nhamba dzose dzenhamba nhatu dzinogona kugadzirwa (4×4×3) pasina kushandisa mamiriro ekuva even.
y-m-40-01.s.s2.r.c: Uku kufunga kunoparadzanisa nyaya umo nzvimbo yeones i0 kubva kunyaya umo i2 kana 4, uye kuverenga wega zvinogoneka nemakadhi asara munyaya imwe neimwe.
y-m-40-01.s.s2.r.d: Uku kukosha kunoverenga nyaya umo nzvimbo yeones i2 kana 4 chete (2×3×3) uye kusiya nyaya umo nzvimbo yeones i0.
y-m-40-01.s.s2.explain: Kana nzvimbo yeones i0, nzvimbo dzehundreds netens dzinoshandisa makadhi 4 asara, saka 4×3=nhamba 12. Kana nzvimbo yeones i2 kana 4 (sarudzo 2), nzvimbo yehundreds ine sarudzo 3 (kusiya 0 nekadhi ratoshandiswa) uye nzvimbo yetens ine sarudzo 3, saka 2×3×3=nhamba 18. 12+18=nhamba 30. Pane imwe nzira. Bvisa nhamba dzisiri even (nzvimbo yeones i1 kana 3: 2×3×3=nhamba 18) kubva panhamba dzose dzenhamba nhatu, 4×4×3=48, uye unowanawo 30.

y-m-40-01.s.s3.hint.0: Ne1, 2, 3, 4, 5, nyora makadhi ose anogona kuva panzvimbo yehundreds kana nzvimbo yeones i2 nekana i4, uye uenzanise.
y-m-40-01.s.s3.hint.1: Tanga nekuverenga makadhi eeven mangani, uye uongorore kana nhamba dzesarudzo dzenzvimbo dzehundreds netens dzichichinja zvichienderana nekadhi renzvimbo yeones.
y-m-40-01.s.s3.o.a: Zvakarurama. Chero nhamba even iri yakaiswa, nzvimbo yehundreds ine sarudzo 4 (2×4×3=24)
y-m-40-01.s.s3.r.a: Uku kufunga kwakaongorora kana sarudzo yekutanga ichichinja nhamba yesarudzo dzekupedzisira, ndokutonga kuti panguva ino haiite.
y-m-40-01.s.s3.o.b: Zvakarurama. Pane makadhi eeven 3 ekuisa panzvimbo yeones, saka 3×4×3=36
y-m-40-01.s.s3.r.b: Pakati pemakadhi 1 kusvika 5, pane maviri chete akaenzana, 2 ne 4. Tanga waverenga zvakare kuti makadhi api anogutsa mamiriro.
y-m-40-01.s.s3.o.c: Zvakaipa. Unofanira kuverenga zviitiko apo ones place i 2 uye apo i 4 zvakaparadzana uye uzvibatanidze
y-m-40-01.s.s3.r.c: Uku i kufunga kunopatsanura kuita zviitiko nenguva. Kuti unofanira kupatsanura kunoenderana nekuti huwandu hwesarudzo dzinotevera hunochinja here zvichienderana nesarudzo yekutanga.
y-m-40-01.s.s3.explain: Kana makadhi asina 0, saka kunyange wakaisa 2 kana 4 pa ones place, makadhi ese 4 akasara anogona kuiswa pa hundreds place.
